2225-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

574-1445-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-4871-7396.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2279-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3899-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3899-7422.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1921-2034-7747.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1368-4478-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4478-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7229.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1894-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4924-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa, Steadfast Guardian enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-997-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-997-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

681-5226-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5226-6621-6664.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2403-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

849-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

985-4289-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

560-1322-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1274-3490-4050-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-6720.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1018-1567.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1912-3007-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Toymaker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3007-4131.description:
Activate Toymaker by paying {1}, tapping it and discarding a card, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

678-4050-4151-4365.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4151-4365.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

224-423-2309-3143-5226.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2309-3143-5226.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing a land, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

1354-1835-2557-4275.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1354-1835-2557-4275.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

2306-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Prosperous Thief does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
2306-3489-3542.description:
Declare Prosperous Thief as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Prosperous Thief from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Prosperous Thief's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Prosperous Thief onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2060-2265-2700-2744-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1029-1506-1742-2396.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger and Ophidian Eye attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
1029-1506-1742-2396.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

1124-1677-2034-2696.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Elementals, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and up to other other creature and/or land you control, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2043-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
2043-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Coretapper that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Activate the token Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1015-1744-1950-2773.notablePrerequisites:
You have three or less opponents.
There are at least two other Dragons and/or Skeletons on the battlefield.
1015-1744-1950-2773.description:
Cast Skithiryx by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Skithiryx enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, giving an opponent at least seven poison counters.
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Skithiryx.
Put all five Skithiryx tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Warstorm Surge triggers for each Skithiryx token.
Resolve the first Skithiryx trigger, giving an opponent at least seven poison counters.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.

1135-2689-3368-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
1135-2689-3368-5231.description:
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Kazuul's Fury and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Kazuul's Fury copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding seven {R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Kazuul's Fury and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Kazuul's Fury copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

389-2736-5248.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving target opponent control of Nine Lives.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying {3}{W}{W}, destroying all artifacts and enchantments.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing its controller to lose the game.

64-4305-4377.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Warden of the Eye.
64-4305-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
The Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
